_comment: Every file under examples/ must appear here exactly once; the validator fails on an
unreferenced file so an example cannot silently go untested. The 'invalid' cases are
the point of this corpus: they are what turns a claim in the design docs into

cases.why: Reference signed envelope, generated by tools/make_policy_vectors.py.
Allowlist mode pinning one stick by exact serial.
Block-all mode with one time-bound 8 h admin exception for a no-serial device.
All tunables inside their documented bounds.
Ubuntu 24.04 host with usbguard present and all capabilities supported.
Ubuntu 22.04 host without usbguard: capabilities report unsupported and the usb_control policy resolves to status 'unsupported' rather than a false green.
Ordinary blocked mass-storage insertion with full attributes.

The hard case from the brief: a device blocked before interface enumeration has a null serial and an EMPTY interface_classes array. The schema must accept this, because a pipeline that requires those fields would drop exactly the events that matter most.
Agent clamped an out-of-range setting and said so, instead of clamping silently.
Mixed batch, exercising the oneOf discrimination between agent and USB events.
An unknown envelope field must be rejected, not silently dropped. Silent field-dropping is how protocol drift and smuggled fields go unnoticed.
key_id must match the ed25519:<16 hex> form, so an algorithm-confusion attempt fails at the schema before any crypto runs.
Version 0 is not a valid policy version; versions start at 1 and must strictly increase.
An Ed25519 signature is exactly 64 bytes, so anything other than 88 base64 chars is malformed.
always_allow_classes omits 'hid'. The schema requires hid and hub so that no policy, however misconfigured, can lock a user out of their own keyboard.
serial_match 'exact' with a null serial would look like a pinned device while actually pinning nothing. The if/then guard forbids it.
Modes are a closed enum; an unrecognised mode must fail closed rather than fall through to a default.
Exception justifications have a minimum length, to discourage 'test' and 'asdf' in an audit trail.

This is the key negative test for 'no arbitrary command execution from the server'. The payload smuggles raw_usbguard_rule, post_apply_command and rules_path; additionalProperties:false rejects all three. enforcerd derives rules from typed fields and never accepts rule text, paths or commands.

heartbeat_seconds 5 is below the 30 s floor. Note the deliberate asymmetry: the SERVER rejects this at creation so the admin gets told, while the AGENT clamps instead of rejecting so it can never brick itself on a value from a newer server.
Privacy boundary. filename and files_copied must be rejected: we record which device was seen and what we decided, never what was on it.
Same boundary, nested: mount_point, content_hash and bytes_copied are all refused.
Vendor ids are lowercase 4-hex-digit strings. '0x090C' would break allowlist matching in a way that silently fails open.
capabilities is required. A device that does not state what it can do must not be assumed able to enforce anything.
